purpose: Calibrate three shared empirical storm/rain closures jointly on conservative independent layer water with the reference-qualified 6.0 K/km environmental partition. Earlier rain-knob joint searches used older concentration-form water; this is a new fixed factorial sensitivity design on the corrected water equations, not a derived atmospheric closure or proof of an optimum. Keep Earth forcing and all physical and observational safeguards unchanged.
physical_definition: Use independent no-mixing lower/upper water, conservative common-mass transport and storms, corrected column convection and precipitation recycling, the fixed 6.0 K/km environmental capacity partition and 7.5 m/s background westerlies. Vary only the eight predeclared combinations of eddy_rate 1.0/1.8, precip_tau_days 8/15 and convective_rh 0.65/0.72. The actual baseline values are 1.434152674408984, 11.078614585004903 and 0.6829148729649469. Eddy rate changes heat exchange as well as vapor redistribution; temperature, modeled SST and circulation respond, and no compensating thermal knob is added. The other two parameters change distinct local dynamic and empirical whole-column rain components, both within the solved water equations. All other shared coefficients, surface-elevation lapse, calibrated absolute capacity/source laws and Earth orbital/radiative/rotation/radius settings remain fixed. Actual layer humidity remains solved; no observed temperature, humidity reset, local multiplier, fitted upper/lower-q ratio or regional/planetary adjustment enters the climate integration. Reference qualification is necessary but is not a coupled environmental-energy solution.
control: 84 actual Earth integrations: seven original r39 controls, seven archived common-mass fixed-profile controls, seven corrected moist original-wind controls and seven archived environmental 6.0 controls, then eight declared shared-parameter combinations on the same seven development regions. All 28 controls precede candidates and reproduce every archived main NPZ fieldset and array exactly. Separate PNW native companions are still recorded and hash-verified. Iberia humidity retains transport_control as its denominator; PNW wind and humidity retain column_control. Neither denominator is replaced by the failed environmental control.
screen: All unchanged safeguards from the environmental-partition plan apply. Strict numerical, conservative vapor/storm, lower/upper and summed-column equations, internal precipitation recycling and all primer/scored profile/lapse certificates must pass; dry-column residual <=1e-10 and branch speed maxima <=60 m/s and p95 <=25 m/s. Against r39 require combined S<=0.995, mean rain ratio<=0.99, aggregate temperature ratio<=1.01, North India rain ratio<=0.95, Iran rain ratio<=1.02 and every other regional S<=1.02. Integrated modeled-SST MAE may increase at most 0.02 C on unchanged observation-only masks. Native North India wind RMSE must improve at least 5%; Iberia ocean and East Australia lowland wind RMSE may worsen at most 2%. Iberia ocean partial-water and partial-q-shape MAEs may each worsen at most 2% against the fresh fixed-profile transport_control. PNW ocean wind vector RMSE must fall to at most 90% of the fresh corrected original-wind column_control, and PNW partial-water and q-shape MAEs may each worsen at most 2% against that same control. All native masks, true areas, pressure ranges and observed fields stay identical. All eight eligible candidates must retain the fixed 6.0 K/km environmental profile and pass its frozen independent three-region thermal AND saturation-capacity reference guard. The reference does not prescribe actual humidity. Keep strict layer/column certificates and exact cancellation of upper-to-lower falling-rain recycling throughout. No new profile, parameter value, masked location, weakened safeguard or altered selection rule after outcomes. These are reused development regions, not independent validation.
advance: maximum_finalists=0 prevents automatic full stages or adoption from this first-stage design. If any declared candidate qualifies under every unchanged safeguard, continue with a separately frozen at-most-two-candidate full31/ocean/fine/established comparison, retaining all current controls and protections and repeating PNW native wind/humidity at 56 and 28 km. The unchanged regional policy, paired finer-grid and established-set checks remain mandatory; world transfer and atlas adoption are separate and cannot follow from screening alone. No thresholds may be relaxed after outcomes.
publication: Report all 84 actual integrations, all eight fixed empirical sensitivity combinations and all numerical/physical/observational failures. The separate thermal reference contributes zero new Earth integrations. Any improved experimental score is distinguished from adopted r39 skill. Preserve earlier failures and frozen source epochs, use the source-change stop and two-hour supervisor ceiling, and publish no replacement normal atlas climate without full Earth and matched-world qualification.

factorial_design.order: Four exact controls in profile order, then the lexicographic Cartesian product of eddy_rate, precip_tau_days and convective_rh; no adaptive extension or replacement after outcomes.

units.eddy_rate: per day before the existing storm envelope; affects heat and moisture exchange
units.precip_tau_days: days in the local dynamic rain coefficient
units.convective_rh: dimensionless activation humidity in the empirical whole-column exponential

publication_map_selection: rain05, the fifth entry (zero-based index 4) in the predeclared eight-corner Cartesian order. This is a fixed middle-index example, not a central parameter combination or score-selected winner.
